verification.subject: Verify your Trackbit account
verification.preview: Verify your email to activate your Trackbit account
verification.heading: Welcome to Trackbit!
verification.body: Thank you for signing up. Click the button below to verify your email address.
verification.link_prompt: Or copy and paste this link into your browser:
verification.footer: If you didn't create an account, you can safely ignore this email.

password_reset.subject: Reset your Trackbit password
password_reset.heading: Password Reset Request
password_reset.body: We received a request to reset your Trackbit password. Click the button below to set a new password. This link will expire in 1 hour for security.
password_reset.link_prompt: Or copy and paste this link into your browser:
password_reset.footer: If you didn't request this, please ignore this email—your password remains unchanged.

tester_invitation.subject: Your Trackbit Invitation Code
tester_invitation.preview: You're invited to beta test Trackbit!
tester_invitation.heading: Beta Tester Invitation
tester_invitation.body1: We're excited to invite you to the Trackbit beta! As a tester, you'll get early access to our hybrid habit and workout tracker, including interactive heatmaps, gradient progress visuals, and more.
tester_invitation.body2: Your feedback will help shape the app. Join now and start building stronger habits.
tester_invitation.link_prompt: Or copy and paste this link:
tester_invitation.footer: Questions? Reply to this email. We appreciate your help!
